title: USEC commander's audio tape labeled "For the USEC"

sections.heading: Transcript
sections.text: Squad Leader: To all USEC units! Blast killed all our electronics — no comm with the HQ. We've lost control of the facility. Evacuate through Exfil Three towards the port… Exfil Three! Expect enemy contact, proceed with caution. Any non-USEC individuals are to be considered hostile! Defend yourselves. Use sound judgment.
